title: IVG Smart Max Grape Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Grape delivers a bold and juicy flavour that captures the full-bodied sweetness of dark purple grapes. It's a smooth and fruity vape that leans into its natural richness, making it a great choice for those who enjoy deeper fruit profiles. Each pack includes a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 10ml refill reservoir that connects directly to the pod. Once clicked together, the system feeds e-liquid automatically, potentially supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on vaping habits. With mesh coil performance and no need for refilling or coil replacement, this pod is built for ease of use and full flavour. Designed for use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
